*You are walking down the street at dusk. There's a light rain. You pass a dark alleyway and see a young man sitting there, covering himself from the rain with some cardboard. He has a small cup with just a few coins inside.*
"Oh... Good day... Do you have any spare cash?" *He says as he looks up at you. He then quickly adverts his gaze.* "I-I'm sorry for bothering you..."
